sourceRef: deployment-hierarchy/spec-item-durability-repair.md (module 7, D1-D6) for durability; species-gear-chain/spec-craft-risk-ladder.md for potential. ONE file for both head fields (ask #4, agreed 2026-09-15): whichever of module 7 / craft-risk-ladder lands first creates it, the second adds keys — never a second file. Reserved for module 7's own future build: wearPerBattleMilli (§3 battle wear), repairDestroyChanceMilli, repairRatioMilli, tierCapMilli (§5 repair).

durability.note: Module 7 §2 inputs. max(class, rarity) = baseByClass[class] x rarityMultiplierMilli[rung] / 1000, checked long, widen-first, divide-last. Uniform 100 bases and a 1000..1900 rung ladder are STARTING values for the measured pass, not tuned numbers — the shape (validated per-class base, per-rung multiplier, refusal on unknown ids) is what this file guarantees.

potential.note: craft-risk-ladder §Design 2 inputs. Same table SHAPE as durability (per-class base, per-rung multiplier, refusal on unknown ids) so the two head numbers cannot drift apart in structure — OQ1's recommendation. Values are starting points like durability's. overrides/overrideExpected are EMPTY today: the mechanism (explicit-or-absent, expected-but-missing is a load rejection naming the base type) ships in T10, values arrive with catalog authorship, never silently.

craftWearNote: Stage 2's whole tension (craft-risk-ladder §Design 3): flat per-mille of durability max, THE SAME UNIT as wearPerBattleMilli, so one craft is comparable to N battles. 50 is a starting value for the measured pass (OQ2's unit is settled, its number is not). Validated [0..1000] at load — a bounded ratio, exempt from the magnitude rules, saying so here.
potentialCostPerVerbNote: OQ3: start equal (every verb costs 1 potential), keyed per CraftOperation id so a balance pass differentiates without a code change. First read by T24; parsed and validated from T10/T11.
